no_interior_contour_policy: occupancy is scored by IoU/precision/recall; if both masks have no interior boundary, boundary score is NOT_APPLICABLE and geometry contour remains unavailable
scope: visible T1 blade union, occlusion retained; not blade identity or field evidence
new_RGB_condition: 128-sample Cycles denoising, same physical scene and same camera/frame/t; new independently captured RGB and background references
reference_condition: same camera, illumination, background; target temporarily absent for independently acquired reference; not available from old four-frame RGB alone
truth_use: evaluation only; never input to segmentation or solver

persistent_root_diagnostic.RGB_pixel_ROI: annulus around principal point K[cx,cy], radius 12..60 original pixels
persistent_root_diagnostic.requirement: report precision/recall separately; no material truth enters masks; no root completion inferred

RGB_tower_difference_diagnostic.scope: indirect illumination mismatch from target-absent reference; thresholds come from RGB pairs, not source silhouettes
